about: Output numbers of kgeo (spin 0) for photonring's cross-check, Stage 8 item 5 part B (tests/unit/cross-check.test.ts). Samples of the design's K1 to K5 at r_o = 100 and 1000 M, inclinations 0, 17 and 78 degrees.

source.functions: r_equatorial, is_outside_crit, Iobs with Velocity('kep'), Velocity('kep').u_lab
source.note: kgeo was called from a separate Python driver run outside photonring's build and tests; no kgeo code is in the repository. Only its output numbers are here.

produced.environment: uv venv at ~/.cache/photonring-crosscheck/kgeo, outside the repository; full pip freeze below
produced.network: denied during every run of kgeo and of its ODE oracle (macOS sandbox-exec profile with deny network*)

conventions.screen: kgeo's Bardeen screen (alpha, beta); lambda = -alpha sin(theta_o), eta = alpha^2 cos^2(theta_o) + beta^2. Mapped to photonring's static observer at azimuth 0 and elevation 90 - theta_o: view direction sqrt(1 - k^2 b^2) forward + k alpha right + k beta up, k = sqrt(1 - 2/r_o)/r_o, b = hypot(alpha, beta)
conventions.order: kgeo's mbar = photonring's order n (crossing n + 1); rs[mbar] for mbar = 0 to nmax + 1, where kgeo returns 0 for the order after its last crossing
conventions.count: kgeo's Nmax + 1 crossings end at the horizon r = 2 for captured rays and at r = r_o on the way out for escaping rays (its maximal Mino time is twice the time from r_o to the turning point); crossings beyond r_o exist but are not counted
conventions.redshift: Iobs g with Velocity('kep') for an observer at rest at infinity (p_t = -1)

oracle.what: kgeo's own ODE oracle, tests/geodesic_ode.py at the same commit, run from ~/.cache/photonring-crosscheck/kgeo-oracle/ (outside the repository)
oracle.provenance: copied (not downloaded) from the copy of kgeo's files read during the design critique, whose four package files equal the installed bc5affe package byte for byte
oracle.method: DOP853 on the oracle's (u, du/dtau, theta, dtheta/dtau) equations; events cos(theta) = 0 re-integrated to the event and corrected by one Newton step; capture u = 1/2, escape u = 0; second run at 10 x rtol
oracle.rsErr: per crossing: |r_kgeo / r_oracle - 1| + |r_oracle,loose / r_oracle - 1|, rounded up to two significant digits: a measured bound on kgeo's error

kgeoInsideUnreliableNote: For b_c - b < 2e-9 b_c (spin 0) kgeo's region III formula calls scipy.special.ellipj with 1 - m < 1e-10 beyond the quarter period, where it loses accuracy (r_s off by up to 30 % at crossing 0 against the oracle). Those rays carry the oracle's radii in 'oracle' and are compared with them.
